evidence.artifact: Original GitHub ZIP, MP4, generated _review.jpg and eight _source_XX_preview.jpg all physically downloaded and inspected locally
evidence.video: FFmpeg independently decoded entire current-run MP4 for freeze, black frames and audio; separately reviewed 12 distributed frames and source action at 17.5, 18.0, 18.5, 19.0, 19.5, 20.0 and 20.4 seconds.
evidence.hook: Visible real gray tabby cat looks around from inside paper bag.
evidence.setup: Separate actual fluffy kitten rests on cushion in an indoor space.
evidence.action: Real black cat walks outdoors then separate gray cat visibly grooms. At 18.0s distinct cat rises and paws at cotton bud; at 21.1s other two cats interact indoors.
evidence.payoff: Separate cat lies outside and receives visible human petting.
evidence.narration: Six recorded English narration blocks, aligned by generated timeline with actual species and separate scenes. No false single-animal continuity or invisible activity observed in reviewed evidence.
evidence.captions: Portrait 1080x1920; captions at lower middle rather than TikTok bottom controls; titles and labels legible.
evidence.freeze: FFmpeg freezedetect -48dB threshold >=1.0s returned zero events.
evidence.black: FFmpeg blackdetect >=0.8s returned zero events; no black bars; source-fit background uses source-derived blur rather than synthetic fill.
evidence.audio: AAC present; mean -28.1 dB, peak -5.1 dB; audible narration waveform confirmed.
evidence.credits: 8 exact creators and source-page/license URLs included in TikTok caption; original metadata includes modified 9:16 crops, subtitle and narration disclosures; CC BY 2.0/4.0 and CC0 sources; in-run Commons source audit passed.
